section5Content1: [TODO AR] We comply with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) and similar regulations. A child's name and age are collected only when a parent or guardian enters them directly through the Parent Portal during account setup — never by the child, and never within the app itself. This information is used solely to personalize the learning experience and is not shared with third parties beyond what's described in this policy.

Parental consent is verified through the account creation and email verification process.
